summary: "Immortal Explorers" is an educational web presentation developed with the support of artificial intelligence that highlights the lasting legacies of five historic space missions: Sojourner, Spirit & Opportunity, Dawn, Pioneer 10 and 11, and Ingenuity. The project addresses the Space Apps challenge through a web page designed so that young audiences can find summarized information in a visual presentation, allowing them to complete the reading in approximately 10 minutes. This turns learning into a simpler, practical, and dynamic task, avoiding the feel of a tedious, hours-long investigation. This initiative is relevant because many young people feel overwhelmed when perceiving that studying requires exhaustive hours of research; "Immortal Explorers" solves this problem while paying tribute to those missions that remain in space and had a fundamental influence on our current discoveries about the cosmos.
details: Our project is a visual presentation featuring concise and direct information, primarily aimed at young audiences and children. It allows kids and youth to learn about space missions dynamically without getting bored by lengthy texts. For its development, we relied on the support of artificial intelligence, utilizing HTML for the structure and organization of the platform's content, along with Tailwind CSS and JavaScript to achieve a modern, interactive, and fully responsive interface.
